body:
Exact PRD ed5776e8 has a concrete contract conflict: sections 2/7/DoD promise exact playback links when the crosswalk is checked, but sections 6/7 require a movable static file:// report with no JavaScript and prohibit local movie paths in artifacts. A path-free, no-JS static artifact cannot open caller-supplied external media.

Smallest truthful revision: the shareable report displays verified PTS and a copyable terminal command whose media path is supplied only at invocation; exact playback is performed by a separate local CLI/runtime command, outside the shareable bundle. Crosswalk verification must certify time mapping, not media reachability. Please incorporate this wording into the current product PRD before its review closes.
